content: Official Microsoft Graph Python SDK is msgraph-sdk 1.65.0 (PyPI 2026-10-22, Python >=3.10, Kiota-based, httpx, azure-identity + kiota dependencies). The old package name microsoft-graph-sdk returns 404 on PyPI. Authentication uses AzureIdentityAuthenticationProvider expecting async azure-identity credentials, which does not fit a delegated MSAL cache stored in Firestore; for a small file-API subset prefer msal + httpx direct REST.
